deviations_from_adr: ADR §3.6 states 'Backed by the choros_app role'; org HTTP pool in src/db/org.ts uses DATABASE_URL which in CI/dev maps to choros_migrator (rolsuper=true, rolbypassrls=true), not choros_app. RLS is therefore not enforced on HTTP org queries in dev. No separate APP_DATABASE_URL env var is wired for the org pool (unlike pgJobStore which supports APP_DATABASE_URL). AC-fitness DB tests that validate RLS use appUrl() explicitly (choros_app), so all RLS correctness tests pass. This is a dev-shortcut, not an AC-fail. Resolution path: T-0022 write-routes will introduce the APP_DATABASE_URL split for the org pool.
